unit.why: A single tale: on his way to R. Elimelekh, the young Seer of Lublin is tempted by an illusory woman in a forest house and resists.
unit.boundary_note: The trailing 'מענין נר' is a section heading that belongs to the next division.

stories.start_quote: סיפר מרן מנסכיז זל"ה שהלובלינר זלה"ה
stories.end_quote: אצל הדרך שהיה צריך ללכת בו
stories.summary_en: As a youth travelling to R. Elimelekh of Lizhensk, the Seer of Lublin gets lost in rain and cold and enters a lit house in the forest, where a beautiful woman tries to seduce him; he refuses, saying he does only what gives pleasure to his Creator, and the whole scene vanishes as an illusion sent to test him.

quotes: קבלתי עלי שלא לעשות אפילו דבר הרשות

tags.why: Sexual temptation is the core of the story.

quotes: ולא ידע מה לעשות אודות יחוד
tags.why: He worries about the prohibition of being alone with a woman.

quotes: כשהלך בנערותו להרהצה״ק ר׳ אלימלך מליזענסק
tags.why: He is on his way to his master.

quotes: והיתה שם רק אשה אחת יפ״ת
tags.why: The seductress drives the plot, though she turns out to be an illusion.

quotes: ראה שהיה הכל דמיון כדי לנסותו
tags.why: A supernatural illusion; it is not clearly sorcery.

quotes: מיד ראה שהיה הכל דמיון כדי לנסותו
tags.why: He realises afterwards that the whole scene was a test.
The tale illustrates the tzaddik's piety and holiness.
The story is framed as told by the rebbe of Neskhiz.
His holiness and chastity are the point of the tale.

quotes: מה שיגיע ממנו תענוג ונ״ר ליוצרי
tags.why: He orients every act toward God.
